body.statement:
Under independent multinomial sampling from \(p\), with an independent margin sample from \(m\) satisfying \(n/n_m\to\lambda\in(0,\infty)\) when present, and with \((p,m)\) in a compact subset of the relevant interior simplices,
\[
\sqrt n(\widehat\zeta_n-\zeta)\Rightarrow N(0,\Omega_\zeta),
\qquad \widehat\Omega_n\xrightarrow{P}\Omega_\zeta
\]
uniformly.  Continuously differentiable maps satisfy the delta method.  For a twice continuously differentiable, locally full-rank restriction of codimension \(q\), the multinomial profile likelihood-ratio statistic has the uniform local quadratic expansion and the \(\chi^2_q\) limit; the corresponding likelihood and Wald confidence boundaries differ by \(o_P(n^{-1/2})\) in Hausdorff distance when the information and restriction covariance eigenvalues are bounded away from zero.

attestation.note: The statement records the finite-dimensional multinomial specialization of the cited central-limit, delta, local asymptotic normality, and likelihood-ratio results; compact-uniformity follows from the displayed interior and eigenvalue separations.
